causes.label: The power supply has been disconnected.
remedies: Use other electrical appliances to check whether there has been a power failure.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "The power supply has been disconnected."

causes.label: The appliance has not been connected as shown in the circuit diagram.
remedies: Connect the appliance in accordance with the circuit diagram.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "The appliance has not been connected as shown in the circuit diagram."

causes.label: Electronics fault
remedies: If you are unable to rectify the fault, inform technical customer service.

causes.label: The control panel is damp or an object is covering it.
remedies: Dry the control panel or remove the object.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "The control panel is damp or an object is covering it."

causes.label: The electronics have overheated, and one or all of the cooking zones have been switched off.
remedies: Wait until the electronics have cooled down sufficiently. Then touch any button on the control panel.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "The electronics have overheated, and one or all of the cooking zones have been switched off."

causes.label: There is hot cookware in the vicinity of the control panel. This may cause the electronics to overheat.
remedies: Remove the cookware. The error display goes out shortly afterwards. You can continue cooking.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "There is hot cookware in the vicinity of the control panel. This may cause the electronics to overheat."

causes.label: There is hot cookware in the vicinity of the control panel. The cooking zone has been switched off to protect the electronics.
remedies: Remove the cookware. Wait a few seconds. Press any button. When the error display goes out, you can continue cooking.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 18: "There is hot cookware in the vicinity of the control panel. The cooking zone has been switched off to protect the electronics."

symptoms.symptom: Home Connect® is not working properly.

causes.label: Various causes are possible.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 19: "Various causes are possible."

causes.label: In certain circumstances, the cooktop can perform self-maintenance tasks, e.g. a firmware update, optimization, or troubleshooting.
remedies: Wait until the process is complete and only then switch the cooktop on.
causes.evidence: Bosch manual, page 19: "In certain circumstances, the cooktop can perform self-maintenance tasks, e.g. a firmware update, optimization, or troubleshooting."
